selection_rule.anchors: For every observed held-out TEST event x damage-class cell, select lexicographically smallest building_id. Sunda-tsunami class 1 is absent in the sealed TEST population, therefore 23 anchors exist.
selection_rule.fillers: Exclude anchors, compute SHA256("DamageACTU-G3-carrier-v1::" + building_id), choose the 73 smallest hashes.

carrier_intermediate.note: Superseded for inference because CSV reserialization introduced harmless floating-point round-trip differences; actual inference uses canonical full manifest plus selector row indices.

important_limits: This lock contains no regenerated inference results.
No tolerance has been selected based on regenerated outputs.
Canonical expert evidence is Seed 42 only.
